::: {#rem-capacity-meaning}
#### What capacity measures

$I(X; Y) = H(X) - H(X \mid Y)$
([symmetry of mutual information](entropy.qmd#thm-mutual-information-symmetric))
is the uncertainty about the input,
minus the uncertainty about the input left after seeing the output.
So $I(X; Y)$ is how much one output tells the receiver about the input,
on average,
and the capacity is that amount when the sender chooses
how often to send each input as well as possible.

:::
